44374-the-robber-baron-of-bedford-castle.title: The Robber Baron Of Bedford Castle
44374-the-robber-baron-of-bedford-castle.creator: Unknown
44374-the-robber-baron-of-bedford-castle.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Great woods, intersected by broad, soft green lanes, overran its northern portion. Traces of these woods and roads still survive in Puddington Hayes and Wymington Hayes, and the great broad "forty-foot." South of this wild wooded upland, one natural feature of Bedfordshire remains unchanged.

45054-essentials-in-church-history-a-his.title: Essentials In Church History A History Of The Church From Th
45054-essentials-in-church-history-a-his.creator: Unknown
45054-essentials-in-church-history-a-his.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. From the time of the exodus from Egypt until the advent of Jesus Christ the Israelites were subject to the laws given to Moses. The belief is held by many that when the Savior supplanted these laws with the Gospel it was the first appearance among men of that great plan of salvation.

arxiv-2011-11637.title: Nudge Attacks on Point-Cloud DNNs
arxiv-2011-11637.creator: Yiren Zhao, Ilia Shumailov, Robert Mullins, Ross Anderson
arxiv-2011-11637.description: Abstract The wide adaption of 3D point-cloud data in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving makes adversarial samples a real threat. Existing adversarial attacks on point clouds achieve high success rates but modify a large number of points, which is usually difficult to do in real-life scenarios.

arxiv-2101-00350.title: Multi-Image Steganography Using Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2101-00350.creator: Abhishek Das, Japsimar Singh Wahi, Mansi Anand, Yugant Rana
arxiv-2101-00350.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Steganography is the science of hiding a secret message within an ordinary public message. Over the years, steganography has been used to encode a lower resolution image into a higher resolution image by simple methods like LSB manipulation.

arxiv-2201-04753.title: Largest Eigenvalues of the Conjugate Kernel of Single-Layered Neural Networks.
arxiv-2201-04753.creator: L. Benigni University of Chicago lbenigni@uchicago.edu, S. Péché LPSM, Université de Paris peche@lpsm.paris
arxiv-2201-04753.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by L. Benigni University of Chicago lbenigni@uchicago.edu, S. Péché LPSM, Université de Paris peche@lpsm.paris. This paper is concerned with the asymptotic distribution of the largest eigenvalues for some nonlinear random matrix ensemble stemming from the study of neural networks. More precisely we consider M = 1 m ​ Y ​ Y ⊤ M=\frac{1}{m}YY^{\top} with Y = f ⁡ ( W ​ X ) Y=f(WX) where W W and X X are random rectangular matrices with i.i.d.

arxiv-2207-07277.title: Optical Properties of Chiral Three-Dimensional Photonic Crystals made from Semiconductors
arxiv-2207-07277.creator: Shun Takahashi 1, Takeyoshi Tajiri 2, Yasuhiko Arakawa 3, Satoshi Iwamoto 4,5, Willem L. Vos 6
arxiv-2207-07277.description: Abstract We perform a theoretical and numerical study of the optical properties of both direct and inverse three-dimensional (3D) chiral woodpile structures, and a corresponding chiral Bragg stack. We compute transmission spectra in the helical direction for finite crystals, and photonic band structures, where we ensure the effective index of all structures to be the same.

arxiv-2208-06413.title: Generating Pixel Art Character Sprites using GANs
arxiv-2208-06413.creator: Flávio Coutinho 1 2 and Luiz Chaimowicz 1
arxiv-2208-06413.description: Abstract Iterating on creating pixel art character sprite sheets is essential to the game development process. However, it can take a lot of effort until the final versions containing different poses and animation clips are achieved. This paper investigates using conditional generative adversarial networks to aid the designers in creating such sprite sheets.

arxiv-2208-10876.title: Spatially resolved gas and stellar kinematics in compact starburst galaxies Thanks: Based on observations collected at the European Southern Observatory at Paranal, Chile (ESO programme 097.B-1061). Thanks: The data cubes, emission line, velocity and dispersion maps are available in electronic form
arxiv-2208-10876.creator: A. Bik, G. Östlin, M. Hayes J. Melinder, V. Menacho
arxiv-2208-10876.description: Abstract Context. The kinematics of galaxies provide valuable insights into their physics and assembly history. Kinematics are governed not only by the gravitational potential, but also by merger events and stellar feedback processes such as stellar winds and supernova explosions. Aims.

arxiv-2212-11922.title: SupeRGB-D: Zero-shot Instance Segmentation in Cluttered Indoor Environments
arxiv-2212-11922.creator: Evin Pınar Örnek, Aravindhan K Krishnan, Shreekant Gayaka, Cheng-Hao Kuo, Arnie Sen, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari
arxiv-2212-11922.description: Abstract Object instance segmentation is a key challenge for indoor robots navigating cluttered environments with many small objects. Limitations in 3D sensing capabilities often make it difficult to detect every possible object. While deep learning approaches may be effective for this problem, manually annotating 3D data for supervised learning is time-consuming.

arxiv-2402-07322.title: Interference Among First-Price Pacing Equilibria: A Bias and Variance Analysis Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2402-07322.creator: Luofeng Liao, Columbia University Christian Kroer, Columbia University Sergei Leonenkov, Ads Online Experimentation, Meta Okke Schrijvers, Central Applied Science, Meta Liang Shi, Central Applied Science, Meta Nicolas Stier-Moses, Central Applied Science, Meta Congshan Zhang, Central Applied Science
arxiv-2402-07322.description: Abstract . Online A/B testing is widely used in the internet industry to inform decisions on new feature roll-outs. For online marketplaces (such as advertising markets), standard approaches to A/B testing may lead to biased results when buyers operate under a budget constraint, as budget consumption in one arm of the experiment impacts performance of the other arm.

arxiv-2403-00252.title: Europa : A Legal Multilingual Keyphrase Generation Dataset
arxiv-2403-00252.creator: Olivier Salaün, Frédéric Piedboeuf, Guillaume Le Berre
arxiv-2403-00252.description: Abstract Keyphrase generation has primarily been explored within the context of academic research articles, with a particular focus on scientific domains and the English language. In this work, we present Europa , a dataset for multilingual keyphrase generation in the legal domain.

arxiv-2404-18809.title: Architecture for fast implementation of qLDPC codes with optimized Rydberg gates
arxiv-2404-18809.creator: C. Poole, T. M. Graham, M. A. Perlin, M. Otten, M. Saffman
arxiv-2404-18809.description: Abstract We propose an implementation of bivariate bicycle codes (Nature 627 , 778 (2024)) based on long-range Rydberg gates between stationary neutral atom qubits. An optimized layout of data and ancilla qubits reduces the maximum Euclidean communication distance needed for non-local parity check operators.

arxiv-2406-00815.title: Baker–Akhiezer function for the deformed root system B ​ C ​ ( l , 1 ) BC(l,1) and bispectrality
arxiv-2406-00815.creator: Iain McWhinnie, Liam Rooke, Martin Vrabec
arxiv-2406-00815.description: Abstract We show that a Sergeev–Veselov difference operator of rational Macdonald–Ruijsenaars (MR) type for the deformed root system B ​ C ​ ( l , 1 ) BC(l,1) preserves a ring of quasi-invariants in the case of non-negative integer values of the multiplicity parameters.

arxiv-2412-13575.title: Generating Long-form Story Using Dynamic Hierarchical Outlining with Memory-Enhancement
arxiv-2412-13575.creator: Qianyue Wang Jinwu Hu Zhengping Li Yufeng Wang, Daiyuan Li Yu Hu Mingkui Tan
arxiv-2412-13575.description: Abstract Long-form story generation task aims to produce coherent and sufficiently lengthy text, essential for applications such as novel writing and interactive storytelling. However, existing methods, including LLMs, rely on rigid outlines or lack macro-level planning, making it difficult to achieve both contextual consistency and coherent plot development in long-form story generation.

arxiv-2505-13237.title: SAKURA: On the Multi-hop Reasoning of Large Audio-Language Models Based on Speech and Audio Information
arxiv-2505-13237.creator: Chih-Kai, Neo, Yen-Ting, Hung-yi
arxiv-2505-13237.description: Abstract Large audio-language models (LALMs) extend the large language models with multimodal understanding in speech, audio, etc. While their performances on speech and audio-processing tasks are extensively studied, their reasoning abilities remain underexplored. Particularly, their multi-hop reasoning, the ability to recall and integrate multiple facts, lacks systematic evaluation.

arxiv-2507-03793.title: Learning Dark Souls Combat Through Pixel Input With Neuroevolution
arxiv-2507-03793.creator: Jim O’Connor, Gary B. Parker, Mustafa Bugti
arxiv-2507-03793.description: Abstract This paper investigates the application of Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) to automate gameplay in Dark Souls, a notoriously challenging action role-playing game characterized by complex combat mechanics, dynamic environments, and high-dimensional visual inputs. Unlike traditional reinforcement learning or game playing approaches, our method evolves neural networks directly from raw pixel data, circumventing the need for explicit game-state information.

arxiv-2510-16203.title: Numerical modeling of laser cooling in molecules: From simple diatomics to polyatomics and radioactive species
arxiv-2510-16203.creator: Felix Kogel, Tatsam Garg, Phillip Groß, Lukas Leczek, Marian Rockenhäuser, Neil Shah, Jakob Weiß, Andreas Schindewolf, Tim Langen
arxiv-2510-16203.description: Abstract Optical Bloch equations and rate equations serve as powerful tools to model light-matter interactions from textbook-like two-level atoms to the complex internal dynamics of molecules. A particular challenge in this context is posed by molecular laser cooling, where many dozens or hundreds of levels need to be taken into account for a comprehensive modeling.

europmc-pmc5877384.title: Trends Supporting the In-Field Use of Wearable Inertial Sensors for Sport Performance Evaluation: A Systematic Review.
europmc-pmc5877384.creator: Camomilla V, Bergamini E, Fantozzi S, Vannozzi G.
europmc-pmc5877384.description: Recent technological developments have led to the production of inexpensive, non-invasive, miniature magneto-inertial sensors, ideal for obtaining sport performance measures during training or competition. This systematic review evaluates current evidence and the future...

pmc-10532965.title: Can BPA Analogs Affect Cellular and Biochemical Responses in the Microalga Phaeodactylum tricornutum Bohlin?
pmc-10532965.creator: Jacopo Fabrello, Maria Ciscato, Emanuela Moschin, Francesca Dalla Vecchia, Isabella Moro, Valerio Matozzo
pmc-10532965.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Bisphenol A analogs (BPA analogs) are emerging contaminants with a rising production caused by the replacement of BPA with these compounds. The increased production of BPA analogs is leading to their increased release into various ecosystems, including marine ones. The aim of this study was to evaluate the biological effects of BPA analogs on a primary producer, the diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum Bohlin.

pmc-11654068.title: Accuracy of symptom checker for the diagnosis of sexually transmitted infections using machine learning and Bayesian network algorithms
pmc-11654068.creator: Nyi Nyi Soe, Janet M Towns, Phyu Mon Latt, Owen Woodberry, Mark Chung, David Lee, Jason J Ong, Eric PF Chow, Lei Zhang, Christopher K Fairley
pmc-11654068.description: BackgroundA significant proportion of individuals with symptoms of sexually transmitted infection (STI) delay or avoid seeking healthcare, and digital diagnostic tools may prompt them to seek healthcare earlier. Unfortunately, none of the currently available tools fully mimic clinical assessment or cover a wide range of STIs.

pmc-12613974.title: Draft genome sequence of Tetramitus sp. JP001
pmc-12613974.creator: Atham Hari Naga Papa Rao, Lakshmanan Vighnesh, Himanshi Bhagat, Chintalapati Sasikala, Chintalapati Venkata Ramana
pmc-12613974.description: We report a 34.6 Mb draft genome of Tetramitus sp. JP001, which was isolated from the rhizoplane of a freshwater Marsilea sp. using Escherichia coli JC875 as prey. Despite their biological and ecological implications, members of the Tetramitus genus are not as extensively studied as other protists.

pmc-12653071.title: Propolis as a Key Source of p-Coumaric Acid Permeating Honey and Sucrose Syrup Stores of Honey Bees
pmc-12653071.creator: Petra Urajová, Václav Krištůfek, Alena Krejčí
pmc-12653071.description: Simple SummaryBeekeepers feed their bees with supplementary saccharide feeding (such as sugar syrup, corn syrup or invert) when honey is harvested from the hive or when natural resources are scarce. These supplementary feeds, however, do not have the same nutritional composition as honey.

pmc-12825177.title: Primary cardiac lipoma: a clinicopathological analysis
pmc-12825177.creator: Shuai Luo, Anying Long, Xiaoxue Tian, Ting Xu, Qiyao Ge, Jinjing Wang
pmc-12825177.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to examine the clinicopathological features of three rare cases of cardiac lipoma.MethodsThis retrospective case analysis utilized a search of the institutional pathology database. Predefined inclusion criteria (pathologically confirmed primary cardiac lipoma with complete clinicopathological data) and exclusion criteria (non-neoplastic fatty lesions, other cardiac tumors, or incomplete data) were applied.

pmc-13063112.title: Future directions and emerging trends of sustainable energy harvesting: innovations in photovoltaic and thermoelectric systems
pmc-13063112.creator: Nadia Anwar, Muqarrab Ahmed, Shaheen Irfan, Muhammad Adnan, Shern-Long Lee, Phuong V. Pham, Chandra Sekhar Rout
pmc-13063112.description: This review seeks to present a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in sustainable energy harvesting technologies, with a focus on photovoltaic (PV), and thermoelectric (TE) systems. It examines the evolution of next-generation PV technologies, such as perovskite and tandem solar cells, which demonstrate remarkable potential for high-efficiency, low-cost energy conversion.

pmc-13083020.title: Detection of mutations: from Ames test to duplex sequencing
pmc-13083020.creator: Niketa Bhawsinghka, Roel M. Schaaper
pmc-13083020.description: Mutation is a biological phenomenon observed in all life forms from viruses to humans. This inescapable process has fascinated scientists for nearly a century. Mutagenicity has become a concern since the 1940s following the discovery that chemicals can cause mutations, because of which the scientific community has ventured into finding effective methods of detecting harmful mutagens.

pmc-13115895.title: Pleuroparenchymal Fibroelastosis in Connective Tissue Disease-Related Interstitial Lung Disease
pmc-13115895.creator: George E. Dimeas, Ilias E. Dimeas, Cathal Doherty, Eamonn Molloy, Zoe Daniil, Cormac McCarthy
pmc-13115895.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis (PPFE) is a rare fibroelastotic lung disease characterized histologically by dense pleural and subpleural fibrosis with upper-lobe predominance. In clinical practice, diagnosis often relies on characteristic radiologic findings, as surgical lung biopsy is rarely feasible. Unlike idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, robust radiologic criteria validated against biopsy-proven cohorts remain limited, and the diagnostic performance of imaging alone is incompletely defined.

pmc-13339802.title: Targeting Network Imbalance in Schizophrenia: The Application of Temporal Interference Stimulation
pmc-13339802.creator: Li Wan, Yiwen Chen, Nuo Chen, Qiong Ye, Shengchun Jin
pmc-13339802.description: Schizophrenia is a highly heterogeneous psychiatric disorder. Antipsychotics have limited efficacy on negative and cognitive symptoms, and are associated with side effects and high relapse rates. The core pathophysiology remains unclear, with most existing studies providing correlational neuroimaging descriptions lacking causal validation and precise intervention methods.

pmc-13360934.title: A Review of Canarii Fructus (Canarium album) Polyphenols: From Efficient Extraction to Mechanistic Understanding and Functional Food Development
pmc-13360934.creator: Jie Ma, Rongqing Yang, Ziqiao Xu, Haonan Zhang, Baozhong Duan, Haizhu Zhang, Fumei He, Yongcheng Yang, Xubing Chen, Conglong Xia
pmc-13360934.description: Canarii Fructus (Canarium album) is a rich source of polyphenols with significant potential for functional food applications. This review summarizes recent advances in the composition, extraction technologies, biological activities, and utilization prospects of Canarii Fructus polyphenols (CFPs). More than 30 polyphenolic compounds have been identified, with gallic acid and ellagic acid as the major constituents, accounting for approximately 38.

pmc-13424517.title: Cerebral small vessel disease impairs dynamic cerebral autoregulation and mediates outcomes after stroke thrombectomy
pmc-13424517.creator: Yue Qiao, Ran Liu, Lupei Cai, Min Zhao, Boyi Yuan, Siying Fan, Shengjun Wang, Jiameng Li, Longfei Wu, Yingqi Xing, Qingfeng Ma, Wenbo Zhao

pmc-13431469.title: Conjoint Analysis of Sheep Microbiome, Metabolome, and Transcriptome Revealed the Effect Mechanisms of Feeding with Broccoli Extract
pmc-13431469.creator: Gang Zhou, Ying Liu, Xuanxuan Pu, Qiugui Ning, Xiaoshan Guo, Liwei Wang, Yuhong Zhong, Guolian Wang, Xuefeng Guo, Mengzhi Wang
pmc-13431469.description: Simple SummaryBroccoli is a widely cultivated vegetable, but its stems and leaves are often discarded as agricultural waste. In this study, we found that broccoli extract altered the expression of hundreds of genes, altered metabolites involved in fat metabolism and vitamin processing, and shifted the gut bacteria composition toward a more diverse community in the small intestine of sheep.
